title: Staying employable: what to keep learning once the studying stops being a track

videos.script: This is the last lesson of the course, and for most of you the last lesson of the track. {{last}} Until now somebody chose what you learned next. From the first job on, nobody will, and the work itself will teach you some things very well and leave others out entirely. {{nobody}} Staying employable is not a matter of chasing every new tool. It is choosing what to learn, learning from the work you are already doing, and knowing when it is time to move. {{choosing}} This lesson does those three, and closes the course.
